benchmarks.disabled_reason: Rodinia 3.1 implementation requires legacy CUDA texture references plus OpenGL/GLUT; modern CUDA toolkits removed the texture-reference API.
The Rodinia 3.1 source hardcodes cudaSetDevice(1) and uses removed texture-reference APIs; it needs a separate source port before selected-GPU measurements are valid.
MUMmerGPU is CUDA 1.x-era code built around removed texture-reference and NVIDIA SDK APIs; it needs a separate source port before modern-toolkit measurements are valid.
